elena: Quick safety tally before tomorrow's midnight change window. Post yes/no and any blockers. I'll collect pins and rollback owners.

sam: Yes from infra. Can confirm dedicated pool warmup ✅

maya: Yes. Release notes uploaded to drive -> https://drive.redwood/release/349. No outstanding test failures.

deploy-bot: Canary run started on canary-3 (service-a:v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0). 10% traffic.

sre-liz: Observability: dashboards look green. Latency 95p within SLO so far. I'll own rollback if we see >3% error rate for 5m.

ops-ryan: Pin list: ```service-a: v3.3.0 (pin)
service-b: v2.8.0 (no-pin)
frontend: v1.12.4 (pin-if-traffic>50k)```

elena: Thanks. @ops-ryan please paste the exact pin command for deploy-bot so oncall can run quickly.

ops-ryan: `deploy-bot pin --service service-a --version v3.3.0 --reason "midnight release" --expires 48h`

andre: Heads-up: hotfix branch ready at commit `a7c4f1b` if we need rollforward. I'll monitor and can push the rollforward patch if required.

sre-liz: Clarify rollback owners: primary @sre-liz, secondary @sam, escalation @elena. Agreed?

sam: Agreed. Also set automatic fallback to service-a:v3.2.1 if canary error >4%.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: service-a pinned to v3.3.0 by ops-ryan. Canary health OK at 12m.

elena: Freeze exemptions: customer-facing docs update permitted until T-2h; no code changes after T-1h without approval from me + infra lead.

maya: Noted. I'll gate PR merges to docs only.

sre-liz: Smoke checklist pre-launch: 1) canary 15m green 2) QA smoke pass 3) tracing hooks validated 4) rollback channel staffed. I'll tick these off when done.

elena: Final ask: everyone reply with a short "ready" if you can be on-call during the window.

sam: ready

maya: ready

ops-ryan: ready

ande: ready

sre-liz: ready — will post ticks in 5m

deploy-bot: Canary complete: health OK, no anomalies. Ready for rollout when human go/no-go is given.

elena: Thanks team. Locking this thread as the official readiness record. Will post go/no-go at T-10m.
